semantic_contract: parse the userspace value with base 10 through kstrtouint_from_user
return -EINVAL on parse failure without logging or invoking a callback
normalize every successful input to boolean zero or one before logging and callback
load the optional callback from tpd_cdev + 0xe40 and pass struct ztp_device * plus int
preserve the stock callback KCFI type 0x6af8b499 and return the original count on success

evidence.raw_relocation_difference: None; raw instruction sequence and normalized relocations match the stock function.

follow_up_required: Run controlled procfs/userspace and NX809J runtime validation after the offline driver set is complete.
unverified: actual procfs ABI behavior and concurrent callback lifetime
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, exact 52-instruction/208-byte AArch64 body, matching function KCFI type and callback offset contract, strict Joern with zero unresolved calls, reproducible Docker build, and three-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract. No smartphone test was performed.
